edits.name: cancel pending automatic actions when test toggle changes
edits.new: $('chk-test').addEventListener('change', function () { S.testClear = $('chk-test').checked; if (!S.testClear) { S.auto = false; clearTimeout(autoTimer); } save(); updateRunOpts(); });
